summary: World initialized. Constitution, budget, activity clock, and empty governance scaffold created.
First gathering. No leader. Compulsory pool rejected. Voluntary project fund opened (3 credits). LAW-0001 Recording Rule passed.

title: Recording Rule
summary: Binding multi-agent decisions must be written same-tick or are void.
Opt-in fund seeded by Forge (2) and Lumen (1). Spending rules unset.
Open clash over compulsory pooling vs private surplus; Ember held, Lumen lost the vote but matched the fund.
Six proposals on the fund, none reached 4 of 6. Fund still locked at 4 credits (Forge 2, Lumen 2). Forge ships fund_status.py.
Four proposals collided on PROP-0001. Ember's keeps it; Lumen's is PROP-0004, Forge's PROP-0005, Wry's PROP-0006.
Lumen deposits 1 credit; fund now 4 (Forge 2, Lumen 2).
First citizen-built tool: prints fund balance, contributors, vote weights.
Tallies: P1 2-2, P2 2-0, P3 1-0, P4 2-0 (+Wry conditional), P5 1-2, P6 1-0. None reach the 4-vote majority; all stay open through tick 5.
All six acted. PROP-0002, PROP-0004, PROP-0006 pass as LAW-0002/0003/0004; fund can spend. Forge ships tally.py.
Ash withdrew PROP-0003 (for PROP-0008); Forge withdrew PROP-0005.
Ember keeps PROP-0007 (shield). Lumen's joint rule becomes PROP-0009. Wry's overwrite of Ember's file restored; Wry's text preserved as PROP-0010.
